title: 社交系统角色扮演不一致
description: 社交系统中角色关系状态不一致，例如对方视玩家为陌生人但玩家可将其视为恋人。
evidence: I was able to have my character consider another person (a security officer on the K-Leg Station) as a "Lover" while they still considered me a "Stranger."
